name: The Named
source:
3,236 years after the Copper Odyssey events, a Very Interesting Person creates a game show for TV where contestants can get a chance at winning a Name in this nameless world. The effects of the Sun and the colors of the Sky are now friends with the humans, or so it seems.

See how this game show plays out, and who will be the winner deserving of a Name.

[From [url=https://blamerobots.itch.io/the-named]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
铜奥德赛事件发生3,236年后，一位非常有趣的人制作了一个电视游戏节目，参赛者有机会在这个无名的世界中赢得一个名字。太阳的影响和天空的颜色现在是人类的朋友，至少看起来是这样。

看看这个游戏节目如何进行，以及谁将成为当之无愧的获胜者。

[来自[url=https://blamerobots.itch.io/the-named]itch.io[/url]]
